# github.com/circleci-functions/setup-go

Install a Go toolchain and link it onto PATH for later steps.

**Version:** v0.5.1-684fd5b
**Latest:** v0.5.1-684fd5b

## Arguments
| Argument | Type   | Default | Description                                      |
| -------- | ------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| version  | string | stable  | Go version spec: a release (1.22) \| stable.     |
| cache    | bool   | true    | Use the job cache. Turn off for hermetic builds. |
